I built a One-Ball balancing robot that I can ride on, and it was pretty quick. There were some issues with static electricity building up and causing it to cut out which I’m still trying to solve, but also steering was pretty difficult originally.
I added some electric ducted fans to blow it around, which was quite successful, but in the last video I also discussed various other methods of controlling yaw – which is the vertical rotation axis.
